definition: This dimension controls the ease or challenge with which players can acquire food or resources to satisfy their hunger clock. Variations can range from readily available resources to scarce and challenging-to-obtain sustenance.
exclusion_criteria: Games that do not incorporate a hunger mechanic
Games where resources can be infinitely generated without effort
inclusion_criteria: Games where food sources are common and easy to find
Games featuring rare or difficult-to-obtain food items
title: Replenishment Difficulty
